h1: Custom Glass Paperweights for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom glass paperweights for your next event or corporate gift. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Glass paperweights offer a polished, professional look that plastic or resin alternatives can't match. Whether you're honoring employee milestones with a Wave Award or adding a decorative touch to executive desks with a Vertical Gem Cut Award, glass provides clarity and weight that conveys quality. These paperweights are ideal for corporate gifts, trade show giveaways, or recognition programs. Choose from clear or frosted finishes and add your logo with precision etching or full-color printing for a lasting impression.
heroAltText: Custom glass paperweights with etched logos on a desk, featuring clear and frosted finishes.
